definitions.explanation: A meeting at which a public figure or organization gives a statement or answers questions from journalists.

examples.japanese: {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister issued a statement at the press conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An emergency press conference was held late at night.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧ (journalist, reporter) + ⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧ (meeting, interview). One of the most common terms encountered in news media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a press conference
- {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct a press conference
- {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend a press conference
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}: emergency press conference
- ⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}: joint press conference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧: meeting or interview (broader; can be a private meeting, not just with press)
- ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: press release or press announcement (often one-directional, without Q&A)
